messages.subject_clean: Loading shape files in Deducer Spatial
messages.body_plain:
Hello there,

Hope you can help. I've downloaded some shape files but when I attempt to load these under Spatial > Load Shape File, I get an error message.
I'm trying to load individual shape files from a batch of unzipped files. I'm probably missing something quite simple, but cant seem to get over this hurdle. Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks

messages.subject: BEGINNING WITH DEDUCER
messages.body_plain:
Hello!

I have begun building GUI for R with Deducer for a short time. I created a dialog for factor analysis in http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/index.php?n=Main.Development#cadw and moved it to menu, but I couldn't add data into the dialog as the picture in the example. Why? And what would I do to add data?

 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-1zx-rJkf0ZQ/WDIeTwpBhmI/AAAAAAAAAJA/koZJ7jvGe1IwCRYzeQDU1EYmm1QzeFQbACLcB/s1600/02.png>

Thanks.

messages.subject: Re: BEGINNING WITH DEDUCER
messages.body_plain:
You need data in your workspace for it to be recognized by the dialog. Do you have any data.frames loaded? Secondly, I highly recommend using Deducer within the JGR console ( just type JGR() ).

Best,
Ian
